why_amended: rule A spells 'assumed'; GBIF wrote 'assumes' in the description of GEODETIC_DATUM_ASSUMED_WGS84, which fires on 5,428,125 records here. Both rules and both selections are reported.
rule_is: this night's reading of the institution's own description text, NOT the institution's classification of its own flags — GBIF publishes the three-way Excluded/Altered/Inferred distinction per record, not per flag

descriptions_of_the_selected.CONTINENT_DERIVED_FROM_COORDINATES: If no value is supplied for the continent or if the values cannot be matched against a known vocabulary, data interpretation derives the continent from the decimal coordinates.
descriptions_of_the_selected.COORDINATE_REPROJECTED: The original coordinates were successfully reprojected from a different geodetic datum to WGS84.
descriptions_of_the_selected.COORDINATE_REPROJECTION_FAILED: The given decimal latitude and longitude could not be reprojected to WGS84 based on the provided datum.
descriptions_of_the_selected.COORDINATE_REPROJECTION_SUSPICIOUS: Indicates successful coordinate reprojection according to provided datum, but which results in a datum shift larger than 0.1 decimal degrees.
descriptions_of_the_selected.COORDINATE_ROUNDED: In the data interpretation the original coordinates are rounded to 6 decimals (~1m precision).
descriptions_of_the_selected.COUNTRY_DERIVED_FROM_COORDINATES: If the country and country code are not supplied or cannot be matched to known values, data interpretation derives their content from the decimal coordinates through a lookup service .
descriptions_of_the_selected.GEODETIC_DATUM_ASSUMED_WGS84: If the datum is null, data interpretation assumes the record coordinates are in WGS84.
descriptions_of_the_selected.OCCURRENCE_STATUS_INFERRED_FROM_BASIS_OF: The present/absent status of the occurrence was inferred from the basis of record value because no status value was supplied explicitly.
descriptions_of_the_selected.OCCURRENCE_STATUS_INFERRED_FROM_INDIVIDU: The present/absent status of the occurrence was inferred from the individual count value because no status value was supplied explicitly. An individual count of 0 is interpreted as status="absent", a value > 0 as "present".
